_comment: CatalystVerse visual style bible. The Director Node checks drafted panel prompts against these tag sets. Extend per scene_type as new visual motifs get established in canon — this file is the single source of truth for 'does this panel look like our universe'.

establishing.description: Wide shots that set a location — market sprawl, bridge, skyline, workshop.

action.description: Kinetic combat or chase panels — Ajele fights, trials, pursuit.

orisha_manifestation.description: A god's power made visible — Bleeds, resonance surges, divine strikes.

character_reveal.description: Close-up, character-defining panels — a hero's first full appearance, a villain's unmasking.

quiet.description: Dialogue-heavy or emotional beats — grief, doubt, quiet resolve.
